title: North Carolina Regulators Reject Duke Energy Gas Power Plant
summary: Natural gas output in the United States is expected to reach record highs in 2026 and 2027, as the country ramps up production and seeks to fill the gap created by restrictions on energy trade through the Strait of Hormuz. However, as the U.S. doubles down on its gas ambitions, a judge has ruled that a North Carolina gas power plant should not proceed. title: Olympics: Germany picks Munich for Summer Games bid
